interpretation_guardrails: CUPTI kernel bars are grid-lifetime intervals, not per-CTA SM-ID traces.
Resource exclusion proves that simultaneously resident blocks from an excluded pair cannot share an SM.
The paired control, not overlap-area arithmetic, measures the net graph latency effect.
A positive control-minus-baseline wall-span delta means native overlap is faster.
